title: Source-factual recipe import extraction
summary: Device-reported tripe import reached Review your card with an invented title, source meat renamed and a long step left timeless: link, pasted and captioned recipes had no SourceRecipeFidelity contract, so nothing bound the card to the source. structuredRecipe now certifies only explicit measured Ingredients plus Method sections and binds title, ingredients, order, quantities and written times through the existing fail-closed gate; unverifiable structure is refused, never generated or demoed. Prompt and quality gates byte-identical. Native/device acceptance UNRUN.
